name: David Ricardo
biography: Named alongside Marx as a later exponent of the labour theory of value, which Russell shows Locke held 'in a vacuum, without hostility to any class,' unlike Ricardo (opposed to landowners) or Marx (opposed to capitalists). Associated with Bentham, Malthus, and James Mill; his 1817 doctrine that exchange value derives entirely from labour is the classical-economics premise from which Hodgskin drew socialist conclusions.
